name: searchUnits

versions.rationale: Typed stub from the seed plan (Metadata schema and storage); throws NotImplementedError until its phase lands.

Implemented on a new FTS5 table, units_fts, filled by rebuildIndex: every query word must match as a prefix, names are also indexed by their camelCase parts so "price" finds formatPrice, and bm25 ranks name hits over docs over rationale. Query text is quoted word by word so FTS5 operators can't cause syntax errors; this is the query behind poetics_search.

docs: Full-text search over names (and their camelCase parts), docs and rationale on SQLite FTS5; every word must match as a prefix, best match first.
